# Venn diagram syntax

<!-- Generated by tools/gen-grammar from packages/diagram-venn/grammar/venn.ebnf. Do not edit: run `pnpm gen:grammar`. -->

Venn diagram syntax (R-PARSE-9, D54): the normative grammar of `venn-beta` diagrams.

The hand-written parser in `src/parser/` implements it; `tools/gen-grammar` builds a reference
parser, a sentence generator, highlighters and the syntax reference page from it. mermaid@12
decides what is valid, this file is fixed to match, and the parser must match this file
(DESIGN §4.4).

**Lexer input.** The lexer reads the diagram body as mermaid@12 handed it to its lexer: front
matter and `%%{…}%%` directives removed; CRLF and CR read as LF; `="x"` inside an HTML tag read
as `='x'`; `%%` comment lines removed and leading blanks trimmed; on a line with
`style…:…#…;` (or `classDef…`) the last `;` dropped; `#name;` / `#123;` entities read as
opaque text that no rule takes apart; and a line break appended. Keywords are matched without
regard to case; ids are case-sensitive.

**Indented text.** After a `set` or `union`, a line of blanks and then `text` is an indented
text node, which takes the sets of that `set` or `union`. This lasts through blank and comment
lines until a line starts with anything else (an indented one too); the depth of the indent is
never compared.

Statements need no separator: one ends where its rule does, so `venn-beta set A` and
`set A set B` are two statements. A `union` names two or more sets declared before it with
`set`; the parser checks that, the grammar does not.

## Grammar

EBNF: `[ x ]` is optional, `{ x }` repeats zero or more times, `x+` one or more times, `|` separates alternatives. Upper-case names and `subgraph`, `end`, `acc_…`, `direction_…` are tokens (see below). A rule marked `@Type` builds an AST node of that type.

A venn diagram is `venn-beta`, then its statements and line breaks. Line breaks may come
before `venn-beta`.

```ebnf
diagram = { NEWLINE } VENN { NEWLINE | statement } EOF ;
```

```ebnf
statement = Title
          | Set
          | Union
          | Text
          | IndentedText
          | Style ;
```

`title <text>`: the diagram title, the rest of the line; one pair of surrounding quotes
is removed, as in `title "Team overlap"`.

```ebnf
Title @Title = TITLE ;
```

`set <id>`: a set, with an optional `[label]` and `:size` (10 by default), as in
`set A["Alpha"]:20`.

```ebnf
Set @Set = SET id [ BRACKET_LABEL ] [ COLON NUMERIC ] ;
```

`union <id>,<id>…`: the overlap of two or more sets declared before it, with an optional
`[label]` and `:size` (10 / n² for n sets by default), as in `union A,B["Both"]:2`.

```ebnf
Union @Union = UNION ids [ BRACKET_LABEL ] [ COLON NUMERIC ] ;
```

`text <ids> <id>`: a text node in the area of those sets, with an optional `[label]` (not
after an id that is a number), as in `text A,B t1["In both"]`.

```ebnf
Text @Text = TEXT ids textId ;
```

`text <id>` on an indented line right under a `set` or `union` (or another such line): a
text node in its area.

```ebnf
IndentedText @Text = INDENT_TEXT textId ;
```

```ebnf
textId = NUMERIC
       | id [ BRACKET_LABEL ] ;
```

`style <ids> key: value, …`: the `fill`, `fill-opacity`, `stroke`, `stroke-width` and
`color` of a set, an overlap or a text node, as in `style A,B fill: #f00`.

```ebnf
Style @Style = STYLE ids field { COMMA field } ;
```

```ebnf
field = IDENTIFIER COLON value ;
```

A quoted value, or words, numbers and colours (joined with one blank).

```ebnf
value = STRING
      | valueToken { valueToken } ;
```

```ebnf
valueToken = IDENTIFIER
           | NUMERIC
           | HEXCOLOR
           | RGBCOLOR
           | RGBACOLOR ;
```

```ebnf
ids = id { COMMA id } ;
```

```ebnf
id = IDENTIFIER
   | STRING ;
```

## Tokens

The lexer works in modes (`INITIAL` and the ones below). In each mode it tries the rules in this order and takes the first that matches; a rule may push a mode or pop back to the previous one. Rules without a token emit nothing.

Modes: `INITIAL`, `bol`, `on`, `onBol`, `indentText`, `quotedLabel`, `label`, `labelEnd`.

Every rule ignores case: a rule for `ab` also matches `AB` and `aB`.

| Modes | Token | Pattern | Action | Doc |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| INITIAL, bol, on, onBol | — | `%%(?!\{)[^\n]*` |  | A `%%` comment after other text on a line, to the end of the line; at the start of a token it takes the character before it. |
| INITIAL, bol, on, onBol | — | `[^}]%%[^\n]*` |  |  |
| bol, onBol | — | `[ \t]+(?=[\n\r])` |  | At a line start: blanks before a line break or before other text are skipped. |
| onBol | INDENT_TEXT | `[ \t]+(?=text\b)` | pop push(indentText) | `text <id>` on an indented line right under a `set` or `union` (or another such line): a text node in its area, which takes that statement's sets. |
| bol, onBol | — | `[ \t]+` |  |  |
| bol | — | `(?=[^ \t\n\r])` | pop | Any other line start ends the indented text lines. |
| onBol | — | `(?=[^ \t\n\r])` | pop pop |  |
| indentText | — | `text\b` | pop |  |
| INITIAL | NEWLINE | `[\n\r]+` | push(bol) | Line breaks separate statements. |
| on | NEWLINE | `[\n\r]+` | push(onBol) |  |
| bol, onBol | NEWLINE | `[\n\r]+` |  |  |
| INITIAL, on | — | `%%[^\n]*` |  |  |
| INITIAL, on | — | `[ \t]+` |  |  |
| INITIAL, bol, on, onBol | EOF | `$` |  | The end of the text. |
| INITIAL, on | TITLE | `title\s[^#\n;]+` |  | `title <text>`: the diagram title, the rest of the line (no `#` or `;`); a bare `title` takes the next line. One pair of surrounding quotes is removed. |
| INITIAL, on | VENN | `venn-beta\b` |  | `venn-beta`: starts a venn diagram. |
| INITIAL | SET | `set\b` | push(on) | `set <id>`: a set, with an optional `[label]` and `: size` (10 by default). |
| on | SET | `set\b` |  |  |
| INITIAL | UNION | `union\b` | push(on) | `union <id>,<id>…`: the overlap of two or more declared sets, with an optional `[label]` and `: size` (10 / n² for n sets by default). |
| on | UNION | `union\b` |  |  |
| INITIAL, on | TEXT | `text\b` |  | `text <ids> <id>`: a text node in the area of those sets, with an optional `[label]`. |
| INITIAL, on | STYLE | `style\b` |  | `style <ids> key: value, …`: the `fill`, `fill-opacity`, `stroke`, `stroke-width` and `color` of a set, an overlap or a text node. |
| INITIAL, on | — | `\["(?=[^"]*"\])` | push(quotedLabel) | A label: `["…"]` as written, or `[…]` trimmed. |
| quotedLabel | BRACKET_LABEL | `[^"]*(?="\])` | pop push(labelEnd) |  |
| INITIAL, on | — | `\[\s*(?=[^\]"]+\])` | push(label) |  |
| label | BRACKET_LABEL | `[^\]"]*?(?=\s*\])` | pop push(labelEnd) |  |
| labelEnd | — | `"?\s*\]` | pop |  |
| INITIAL, on | NUMERIC | `[+-]?(?:\d+(?:\.\d+)?\|\.\d+)` |  | A size or a number in a style value. |
| INITIAL, on | HEXCOLOR | `#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}` |  | A colour in a style value: `#` and three to eight hex digits, `rgba(…)` or `rgb(…)`. |
| INITIAL, on | RGBACOLOR | `rgba\(\s*[0-9.]+\s*,\s*[0-9.]+\s*,\s*[0-9.]+\s*,\s*[0-9.]+\s*\)` |  |  |
| INITIAL, on | RGBCOLOR | `rgb\(\s*[0-9.]+\s*,\s*[0-9.]+\s*,\s*[0-9.]+\s*\)` |  |  |
| INITIAL, on | IDENTIFIER | `[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9\-_]*` |  | An id, a style key or a word of a style value: letters, digits, `_` and `-`, starting with a letter or `_`. |
| INITIAL, on | STRING | `"[^"]*"` |  | A quoted id or style value; one pair of quotes is removed. |
| INITIAL, on | COMMA | `,` |  |  |
| INITIAL, on | COLON | `:` |  |  |

Removed before lexing (highlighted only):

- COMMENT: `^[^\S\n]*%%(?!\{)[^\n]+`
- DIRECTIVE: `[^\S\n]*%%\{[\s\S]*?\}%%`
